The handout allows AI coding assistants with accountability: record what we asked, what came back, what we changed or rejected, and **who verified it**. Every member must be able to explain and defend any AI-assisted code.

**Tool used:** Claude (Anthropic), in claude.ai. Most of the source code, tests and documents in this repository were generated by Claude from our requests, then reviewed and revised through follow-up requests.

**How to fill this in honestly:** the "Verified by" column must name the member who actually read and checked that part, and "How verified" must say what they did (read the code, ran the tests, tried it in the browser, explained it to the team). Leave a row as **NOT YET VERIFIED** until that has happened. Do not mark a row verified on someone's behalf.

## What the AI's own checks covered (not a substitute for ours)

While generating code, Claude ran the automated test suite (195 tests, on SQLite and PostgreSQL) and browser walkthroughs with screenshots. These show the code runs; they do not replace a team member reading, understanding and verifying each part.
